changes.reason: Initial capture on main 64b873f9fb (before the INT8 attention nearest-family fallback): every lever each profile engages today, incl. the ones the future-arch and live-regression review flagged.

Guard follow-ups: the offloaded / streamed tier in the speed-layer table (autoopt_offload cells, graphs armed after placement), the speed layer at the family's resolved compute dtype (fp16-incompatible families run fp32 on fp16 cards, as a real T4 Qwen-Image load did) and any.unset_speed_may_compile (fp16 cards compile only on an explicit tier, as a real T4 default load did); found by the R1-R3 replays and a Colab T4 / L4 / A100 / G4 real-card cross-check. No production change.

Recheck fixes, no production change: the INT8 GEMM records the tile tile_for serves per production shape (H3 fused QKV / FFN down, Qwen-Image-2.1 MLP in / down, a short call) after the real device_config; the segment-quant cells record the resolved value (an unrecognised refusal is off) plus the tight-load auto pick; the offloaded cells record what arm_graphs_after_placement installs (still named cuda_graph_after_placement; an offload-only family whose sole refusal is the hook-less stub staying resident keeps it, as its real offloaded load arms) instead of the pending flag; the mock declares the host environment (torchao, fp16 accumulation, Linux / macOS, no XPU, NVRTC 13.0) so every host resolves this golden. Cell ids, item names and the profiles block keep their meaning; the per-shape tiles and the tight-load pick are new cells.

Recheck round 2, no production change: the speed cells read the real compile-runtime decision and the real install_cuda_graphs (no pinned True); any.int8_gemm.install_gate is the real diffusion_int8_gemm.install() outcome on a denoiser with one eligible int8 Linear (off with installs_nothing when it installs nothing); offloaded cells that record cuda_graph_after_placement gain an arming key naming the branch that armed (resident on the hook-less stub, deferred for offload-only Wan); MPS rows take Studio's resolver: bf16 when the bf16 probe passes (the existing mps.*.autoopt rows, which were fp16) and fp32 when it fails (new mps.*.autoopt_fp32 rows). Cell ids, item names and the profiles block keep their meaning.

macOS host safety, no production change: the MPS profile pins Studio's on-device bf16 probe to its declared macOS 14+ answer (bf16) and every other real Metal / MPS reading (torch.mps memory readings and sync, the VAE Metal sync, the working-set reader), so a Mac host never touches its own device (a paravirtual macOS runner crashed in the probe). mps.any.device_target moves from mps/mps/float32 (the Linux host's failing probe) to mps/mps/bfloat16; the probe-fails branch is the new row mps.any.device_target_fp32 (mps/mps/float32).

Recheck round 3, no production change: the offloaded speed cells place accelerate's whole-module CPU-offload hook after the speed layer (the loaders' order) and read the real arm_graphs_after_placement on that moved denoiser, so arming records the offloaded placement (arming: model_stable) instead of the hook-less resident branch, and Wan 2.2 5B arms there instead of being deferred; a dual-DiT MoE (Wan 2.2 A14B) records each expert's engagement (experts key) and a missing expert view loses the cell; the matrix child starts from an allowlisted environment and every UNSLOTH_* setting is cleared per profile.

INT8 attention: an unlisted NVIDIA arch newer than a measured one is offered the nearest lower measured CUDA config that fits its shared memory (h100 / b200 / sm103 / sm110 -> sm89's, sm121 -> sm120's); sm130 stays 16-bit (no_nvrtc_target) because the declared NVRTC (13.0) cannot target it. The per-card accuracy verdict and the timing race against the 16-bit incumbent still decide, and every secondary card of a multi-GPU load races on its own.
H3 video: the INT8 exact-start policy (step count, the 16-bit kernel the exact calls run) is a per-profile cell
H3 video: the exact-start cell records what the load installs (inactive where Auto INT8 attention cannot engage)
gfx1151 hd128 INT8 attention: long calls with 56 heads store V^T block by block (long_vblk_heads)

Tester R5 / R8 / R9 runtime decisions: int8 CUTLASS routing per family after the real race (with #19807 pair check) on a clock-modelled card, the deferred race schedule under back-to-back renders, MiniMax-H3 video placement

#19874: gfx11 (gfx1151) re-stores Linear weights with row pitch K+64 outside TunableOp-covered GEMMs; rocm_weight_pitch engages on every gfx1151 speed-layer cell (resident and offloaded). Wan 2.2 A14B records it on expert 0 only because the pipe-level install arms transformer and transformer_2 in the first view; both experts are padded.
